title: ctenitis ampla
intro: Ctenitis ampla, commonly known as the Broad-leaved fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Ctenitis ampla include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat wounds. The bioactive constituents of Ctenitis ampla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and immunomodulatory effects.
